summary: Antares Private Credit Fund filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a regular monthly distribution of $0.1827 per share, record date September 29, 2026, payable October 28, 2026, in cash or via reinvestment. It also reported August 31, 2026 NAV per Class I share of $24.70, aggregate NAV of roughly $820.9 million, loan commitments of $2,051.2 million, debt outstanding of about $903.3 million, and net leverage of 1.07x, plus continuous offering status. No special-situation event, transaction, or board recommendation is present; no deal terms apply.
